clue.text: 21 weeks and 3 days before 15's place …

parts.note: twenty-one weeks is 147 days, and three more make 150, which is CL in Roman numerals
an eve is the day before an event, so days before are eves

explanation.surface: A countdown of weeks and days leads into a mysterious place belonging to someone numbered 15.
explanation.walkthrough: A count of days is turned into a Roman numeral. 15 is ANNE, so her place is Cleves: Anne of Cleves was Henry VIII's fourth wife.
explanation.definitionFit: Anne of Cleves took her title from the German duchy that was her home territory.

clue.text: Girl's name for archbishop among spies

indicators.note: the archbishop is placed inside the spies, so among signals a container

parts.note: the CIA is the US intelligence agency
William Laud was Archbishop of Canterbury under Charles I

explanation.surface: A girl is named after an archbishop who mixes with secret agents.
explanation.definitionFit: Claudia is a female forename of Roman origin.

clue.text: 12 that's weird

parts.note: 12 is EVERMORE, and e'er is a poetic contraction of ever, always
i.e. abbreviates id est, that is

explanation.surface: Another entry's word is described as strange.
explanation.walkthrough: 12 is EVERMORE; its poetic equivalent e'er gives EER.
explanation.definitionFit: Eerie means strange and unsettling, a synonym of weird.

clue.text: Conqueror pursuing English needs a bouncer

indicators.note: pursuing means following behind, so the conqueror comes after English

parts.note: a victor is one who conquers

explanation.surface: A conqueror chasing an Englishman requires a doorman.
explanation.definitionFit: An evictor throws people out, which is what a nightclub bouncer does.

clue.text: … then 13 and a quarter in a pile …

indicators.note: the quarter is placed inside the pile, so in signals a container here

parts.note: a hoard is a heap or pile of things stored up
W, west, is one of the four quarters of the compass

explanation.surface: A chain of wives continues with another number and a quarter tossed onto a heap.
explanation.walkthrough: 13 is CATHERINE; this clue gives the surname of Catherine Howard, Henry VIII's fifth wife, continuing the chain of linked clues marked by the dots.
explanation.definitionFit: Catherine Howard was one of the Catherines who married Henry VIII, so the surname stands for a 13.

clue.text: Nothing's happening to the pointed arches

parts.note: nothing is zero, the letter O
as in 'what gives?', gives means is happening

explanation.surface: Nothing is going on with the Gothic arches.
explanation.definitionFit: Ogives are pointed arches, as in Gothic architecture.

clue.text: A nice cut keeps misanthrope looking like metal

indicators.note: the cut word holds the misanthrope inside it, so keeps signals a container
cut means the word loses its last letter

parts.note: Timon of Athens, in Shakespeare's play, is the archetypal misanthrope

explanation.surface: A pleasant trim conceals a hater of mankind with a metallic look.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cut' docks the last letter of 'nice'. Timon of Athens is Shakespeare's misanthrope, a reference the solver may need.
explanation.definitionFit: Antimonic means of or like antimony, a brittle silvery metalloid element.

clue.text: Killer in low joint came to 20's 13 and 1 across's 15

indicators.note: the killer is placed within the low joint, so in signals a container

parts.note: a dive is a disreputable bar or club
an orc is a killer whale

explanation.surface: A killer in a seedy bar arrives at a pair of royal wives.
explanation.walkthrough: 20 is ARAGON, 13 CATHERINE, 1 across CLEVES and 15 ANNE: both those marriages of Henry VIII ended in annulment, here called divorce.
explanation.definitionFit: Divorce is what Catherine of Aragon and Anne of Cleves came to, their marriages to Henry being dissolved.

clue.text: Bond's plan used by our husband?

definitions.meaning: Henry VIII let some wives go on living and had others executed

explanation.definitionFit: The Bond film title neatly sums up Henry's treatment of his wives: some survived, some were beheaded.

clue.text: … then 13's little fish

definitions.meaning: the surname belonging to a Catherine, namely Henry VIII's sixth and last wife
a young salmon in its early river stage is called by this name

explanation.definitionFit: Catherine Parr was Henry's last queen, and parr also names a young salmon before it goes to sea.

clue.text: Ability to act without orders is the first step

definitions.meaning: the quality of acting on one's own judgement without being told
taking the lead or opening move in some matter

explanation.definitionFit: Initiative means both self-starting enterprise and an opening move, as in taking the initiative.

clue.text: An impression about 5 is coming

parts.note: the article gives the letter A

indicators.note: the impression goes around the number, so about signals a container

parts.note: a dent is an impression pressed into a surface
five is V in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: A mark made around five is approaching.
explanation.definitionFit: An advent is an arrival or coming, especially the coming of Christ celebrated before Christmas.

clue.text: Remove re-moved for good

indicators.note: moved suggests letters shifted into a new arrangement, so the words before are rearranged

explanation.surface: A wordplay on removing and moving again, done permanently.
explanation.walkthrough: The hyphenated 're-moved' splits in two: its first half is kept as it stands and 'moved' tells you to rearrange the letters of the opening word.
explanation.definitionFit: Evermore means always or for all time, the same idea as for good.

clue.text: Mutiny seizes the right partner for a short 14 unknown otherwise (No. 8) …

definitions.text: partner for a short 14 unknown otherwise (No. 8)

indicators.note: the mutiny takes hold of the other letters, so seizes signals that they go inside it

parts.note: The Caine Mutiny is a famous novel and film, so the mutiny is the Caine
taken as written

explanation.surface: A rebellion grabs the right spouse for someone whose name is shortened and otherwise unknown.
explanation.walkthrough: 14 is HANKERING; shortened it gives HANK, a nickname for Henry, and 'No. 8' is Henry VIII, who had three wives of this name.
explanation.definitionFit: Three of Henry VIII's six wives bore this first name, so it fits a partner of Hank the Eighth.

clue.text: Want a skein and a string around Ireland

indicators.note: the skein and string go round Ireland, so around signals a container

parts.note: a hank is a coiled length or skein of yarn
G is one of the strings of a violin or guitar
Erin is a poetic name for Ireland

explanation.surface: Someone wants a skein of yarn and string wrapped round Ireland.
explanation.definitionFit: A hankering is a longing or yearning, a want.

clue.text: … then another from Guy Mannering …

indicators.note: the letters are taken out of the middle of the novel's title, so from signals a hidden run

explanation.surface: Another name is drawn from a Walter Scott novel.
explanation.walkthrough: Guy Mannering is a Walter Scott novel. 'Another' continues the chain of Henry VIII's wives: Anne Boleyn and Anne of Cleves.
explanation.definitionFit: In the chain of royal wives this gives another of them, a forename two of Henry's queens shared.

clue.text: … then another with a month on a drug

parts.note: Jan is the usual abbreviation for January
E is slang for the drug ecstasy

explanation.surface: Another person arrives with a month spent on drugs.
explanation.definitionFit: Continuing the list of royal wives, this gives the first name of Jane Seymour, Henry's third queen.

clue.text: Fellow Scot's sweetheart: he goes round upsetting pub

parts.note: jo is a Scots word for a sweetheart, as in Burns's John Anderson, my jo

indicators.note: HE is wrapped around the other letters, so goes round signals a container

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: in a down clue, upsetting turns the word upside down, reading it backwards

parts.note: an inn is a pub

explanation.surface: A Scottish lover circles while upsetting a pub.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upsetting' suits a down clue, where reading upwards turns the pub over. Jo for sweetheart is Scots, best known from Burns.
explanation.definitionFit: Johnnie is an informal word for a man or chap, a fellow.

clue.text: Good girl, an example to the cabinet?

parts.note: lass is an informal word for a girl
a case is an instance or example of something

explanation.surface: A well-behaved girl serves as a model for government ministers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cabinet' suggests the ministers of government, but here it is a display cabinet.
explanation.definitionFit: A glass case is a glazed display cabinet for showing objects.

clue.text: Zeus' brother achieved minus

indicators.note: achieved here means brought about or made, so the letters are reworked into something new

parts.note: the god's name taken as written

explanation.surface: The brother of Zeus accomplished a deficit.
explanation.walkthrough: Zeus's brothers were Poseidon and Hades, but no brother is meant: ZEUS and BRO are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Sub-zero temperatures are below zero, that is minus figures.

clue.text: 16 across heard to have improved vision

indicators.note: heard signals that the phrase is said aloud and spelt differently

parts.note: to see more is to have better sight

explanation.surface: A woman is reported to have sharper eyesight.
explanation.walkthrough: 16 across is JANE: Jane Seymour was Henry VIII's third wife.
explanation.definitionFit: Jane Seymour was Henry's third queen, so her surname stands for this 16 across.

clue.text: Wearing shoddy garment in 13's place

parts.note: a rag is a shoddy garment, read here as a rag
having clothes on is wearing them

explanation.surface: Dressed in tatty clothes in a royal wife's homeland.
explanation.walkthrough: Wearing a shoddy garment is having 'a rag on'. 13 is CATHERINE, and Catherine of Aragon came from the Spanish kingdom of that name.
explanation.definitionFit: Aragon was the Spanish kingdom from which Catherine, Henry VIII's first wife, came.

clue.text: Expert covered with piece of cloth, consequence of flukes

indicators.note: the expert is wrapped inside the cloth, so covered with signals a container

parts.note: a sheet is a large piece of cloth
a pro, short for professional, is an expert

explanation.surface: A professional is draped in a cloth after some lucky shots.
explanation.walkthrough: Flukes look like lucky breaks, but here they are liver flukes, parasites that cause this disease in sheep.
explanation.definitionFit: Sheep rot is a liver disease of sheep caused by parasitic flatworms called flukes.

clue.text: Good line in landscape included by 15

indicators.note: the line sits inside the word for good, so included by signals a container

parts.note: bon is French for good
a ley line is a supposed alignment of ancient sites across the landscape

explanation.surface: A fine line in a country scene is taken in by someone named 15.
explanation.walkthrough: 15 is ANNE, and this gives Anne Boleyn, Henry VIII's second wife.
explanation.definitionFit: Anne Boleyn is the most famous Anne among Henry's wives, so her surname stands for this 15.

clue.text: Cease to prevent rising

parts.note: let is an old word for hinder or prevent, surviving in 'without let or hindrance'
up describes rising, as in getting up

explanation.surface: Stop someone from getting up.
explanation.definitionFit: To let up is to stop or ease off, to cease.

clue.text: I sing — I used, anyway — not looking myself

indicators.note: anyway means in any manner at all, so the letters before are jumbled

explanation.surface: A singer explains they sing however they like while out of sorts.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone in disguise does not look like themselves, which is the sense of not looking myself.

clue.text: Use horn both ways

indicators.note: the word reads the same forwards and backwards, so both ways signals a palindrome

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: A driver sounds the horn in either direction.
explanation.definitionFit: To toot is to sound a horn briefly, so it means to use a horn.

clue.text: Direction about spirit as a source of power

indicators.note: the direction goes round the spirit, so about signals a container

parts.note: ENE is the compass direction east-north-east
gin is a spirit

explanation.surface: Pointing a compass direction around a spirit as a source of energy.
explanation.definitionFit: An engine is a machine that converts energy into motion, a source of power.

clue.text: Hat used on 22 and 4?

definitions.meaning: a top hat is informally called this
one who tops, that is beheads, as the executioner did to Anne Boleyn and Catherine Howard

explanation.definitionFit: A topper is a top hat, and also one who tops, executing by beheading as was done to two wives.
